newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on continued buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on continued buying.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be steady on Monday with Friday's buying trend seen continuing on perceptions that the economy was fundamentally strong, brokers said.
"Some investors will continue to buy stocks which made gains on Friday. Local investors could focus on counters which might split the value of their stocks," one local broker said.
He said some investors would also eye counters which were to announce 1996 dividends.

Brokers said the strong rise on Friday on Wall Street would also boost local sentiment while a World Bank report on the economy last week is seen favourable because of its positive comments on the country's strong economic fundamentals.
But they said a further correction might continue on banking stocks after it had risen gradually recently.
On Friday, the Jakarta composite index closed up 0.53 points, at 712.22 points.
